column1: # --relative on/off. Changes the wtmul (multiplicative) term of the weight
# transfer: instead of wtmul/1000 * source_weight, transfer
# wtmul/1000 * (source_weight - min_weight), clamped at 0. pow/additive terms
# unchanged. With min_weight=0 the two are identical, so this isolates the
# effect of scaling the transfer by weight-above-floor (default min_weight=10).
